gloss_en: mezuzah — the parchment scroll affixed to the doorpost (the mitzvah of 'you shall write them on the doorposts of your house'), which in Likutey Moharan I:23 is expounded (via the wordplay zuz/mezuzah and Shaddai as covenant) as a remedy that nullifies the craving for money and draws livelihood; not the plain architectural doorpost per se, nor coins (zuzim)
